verdict.rationale: Shopify documents a Storefront Catalog MCP server that exposes each merchant's product catalog (title, description, price, media, variants) via a documented API at {shop}/api/ucp/mcp, plus a Global Catalog MCP server for cross-merchant discovery, both governed by the published UCP catalog spec with schemas and filters — this is exactly a documented feed/API for agent-surface catalog discovery. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs, and clearer detail on merchant-side setup/import steps versus automatic exposure of existing store data.
